content: While some transportation reports focus extensively on historical truckload rates and reefer rejections without directly examining the mineral processing sector, the overarching theme of constrained supply chains highlights a potential bottleneck for mines relying on external facilities. Additionally, broader transportation infrastructure trends, such as the projected growth in electronic toll collection systems, reflect an ongoing modernization of regional logistics [31] . Although forecasts projecting a compound annual growth rate for electronic toll systems through 2040 focus on highway infrastructure rather than mineral beneficiation, they indicate a shifting landscape in transportation overheads. For Veralogix Plant Operations, maintaining competitive intelligence requires not only monitoring the emergence of new extraction sites but also continuously evaluating the freight capacities and transportation costs that enable the physical delivery of ore. Similarly, the International Energy Agency predicted that global coal production would decline in 2026 due to high stock levels and lower prices, maintaining overall demand on a plateau through the 2025 and 2026 periods [54] . These macroeconomic indicators set the foundational stage for toll processing dynamics, as declining raw extraction volumes mandate that producers maximize the metallurgical and caloric value of every ton mined through efficient processing and washing services. Toll processing, a specialized service where raw coal is refined to improve its quality and marketability, is highly sensitive to these macro-level supply and demand shifts. While localized United States coal production remained relatively stable in late May 2026, the broader multi-year trend points toward structural changes within the industry [55] . Pricing dynamics further illustrate the volatility within the sector, with coking coal prices opening 2026 at 201 per ton and thermal coal at 108 per ton [52] . This market volatility is heavily underscored by conflicting global pricing trends; rising prices driven by energy market uncertainty contrast sharply with falling prices resulting from weak Asian demand [53] . Producers increasingly rely on outsourced processing capabilities to rapidly adjust product specifications in response to fluctuating raw commodity prices, thereby optimizing their profit margins even when raw extraction volumes are constrained.
